My monthly rp/lore for expansion(mind you its a bit long) :O

[spoiler=Geting tings in order before a new step.][u][b]The Nordiheimian councils order of buisiness 981-985 AD[/b][/u]

The last four years might not have seemed to exiting to most Nordiheimians but for their council it had been a small yet busy period, when one mater had been adresed or solved another would allready be laying on their great table treathening to start collecting dust if not dealt with quickly, so they constantly had someting to do, some liked this as it was proof of how important this period of time was for Nordiheim while others felt that it could lead to tings being missed or not solved propperly.
Tough only time would tell if that was the case.

[b]The mater of the unexpected religous expansion in the south[/b]
The first mater they had to address was the expansion to the southern shores of Lake Lifvatn by the more religous people of sorland at the word and blessing of the rather young High Priest of the Asatru religion.
Some ministers in the council was convinced he did this without telling or talking with them about this before hand to show his critics that he had the same power and divine blessing as his predecesor, who had been the one that had proclaimed that the Nordiheimian nobles had lost the gods favor in 900 AD and therefore had been popular with the people, and that the claims that his youth would make him a potential puppet to the council instead of a voice for the gods was noting but the worthless words of those with faith.
Even now more pilgrims and those that seeked a chance to be closer to valhalla and the gods travelled there to search for glowing rocks and sett up their new religious settlements.

While some ministers did not like this others could see opportunity to salvage the situation into someting good, they knew that sorland had been having a bit of a problem with its population being to big for it to propperly feed and house as the land was less fertile then its neighbor region of vestland that had several rivers runing trough it to feed its farms with the water it needed, someting sorland did not have, as such this movement of mostly sorlandians more or less solved this problem as the land they were now settling actualy had usable farmland and even a decent siced wethland, someting that had been overlooked by explorers sailing the lakes shores in earlier years as much if it had been hiden behind hills.
But it all had to be properly documented and maped so that Nordiheim diden't lose track of what the land contained, joust how many were traveling there and were they setteled, as such they needed to find the proper people to send there to do this as well as making the plans for a local fort to use as a base of operation for goverment officials.

It had also presented another question to be answered, would this land be the start of a new region or would it simply be an extension of the sorland region, most agreed that it would be easiest to have it be part of the sorland region since most of the people there was sorlandians and they would have no problem listening to the sorlandian goverment officials.
The young high priest had also agreed to help in this endavor, tough he had demanded with great vigor and newfound power behind him that a new minister position be made in the council of Nordiheim wich would be the 'Minister of Rites', while some was rather ageinst this such as the minister of law since the person in this position would be the high priest himself the minister of wisdom pointed out that not only would the Nordiheimian people not mind this it would also make it far less likely that someting like this religious expansion would happen without the councils knowledge again as they would have more direct contact with the high priest.

Whit this mater more or less given a solution the council could start to look at another and much bigger mater of consearn.

[b]How to find out the true extent of the Golden nobles land and their Dragon Warrior armies[/b]
The more reports that was sendt to them from their people and shadow keepers the more obvious it had become that the blasted golden nobles had not been truthfull about were the actual borders of their lands and holdings had actualy been, some of it had allready been discovered both by accident and investigation, but it was actualy proving difficult to trully to pierce the veil of their secrets as they tried to get a look at the the tings that they actualy cared about without some type of good reason to blind them with.
Luckely the shadow keepers that they had dedicated to looking trough the old lore and information contained within the Golden Library had revealed many lost tings to them, everyting from weapons, blueprints of ships and old imperial traditions and tricks to keep a leash on nobles and their ambitions.

One of these was a competition to be had among the nobles to messure who had done the greatest work in maintaining and grow the old Scandican empire were the holdings, personal armies and conquests added to the greatness of the empire was shown off by each noble family and used to not only rank them in the hierarchy of nobles but also revard the greatest one with a great price from the emporer to show them how much he appriciated and valued their work to make the empire greater.
But in truth this was all joust a fancy scheme by the imperial family to allow them to record as much important information about how each noble was doing and to know wich noble house was geting weak enough to exploit or powerfull enough to challenge them and therefore be kept in check or even destroyed if needed.

Such a competition would create the perfect opportunity to not only send out people to take a look at and record everyting they had both in land and military power, it also presented the posibility that if the price offered to the winner was juicy enough for the golden nobles to be blinded by their greed and desire for recognition of their great power and prestige that they would joust straight up show them everyting they had by their own free will in an atempt to claim it.

Tough while they had allready sendt Lars of Smør, Knuts younger brother, to find someting to be used as such a price or craftsmen to make it as he was recogniced as someone with great tallent for such a task it would most likely take some time for him to achive this task, the council also needed to do some expansion of their regions of sorland, vestland and midland so that they not only had their pretend nobles fall behind the golden nobles in power but also make sure they weren't to powerfull either as to give them a reason to do someting stupid.
Aboria would not be a problem as that region were still slowly expanding on its own as more tribes and villages kept joining them both for the protection it brought them aswell as the prosperity from the new trade that was going trough and from Irohgrad, and it also helped that Chief Yarramundi and other local chiefs did great work in helping these new people join with less problems.
But the three original regions of Nordiheim would need more work as the expansion would need to be made to look like it wasen't joust fresh expansion that had joust been done, they needed to have the structures and look of border land that was well established to sell it as propper land of nobles incase any of the golden nobles wanted to have some of their own people to go with the judges and examiners to not only make sure there was not cheating but proberly to get a bether idea of were they was in the hierarchy, they had no doupt that the house of Tyrsblod wich Lord Haakon was the head of would do this as he had shown that he was more clearminded and suspicous of the "Norse Empire of Nordiheim" then many of his fellow golden nobles.

The council chose carefully from the people they trusted to achive such a goal aswell as use the lists of skilled craftsmen and architects that they had made when they gathered people to make the fortifications in Aboria together with the reports of who did the best jobs and showed the greatest skill in achiving the tasks they had been given.
For the easthern expansions of the regions of Midland and vestland they chose Olaf Balunsen and Daku Tausen, they had a good skills when it came to planing and logistics and had worked together several times before wich would be important in expansion alon the Red wall mountain and the land along it as it was known to be somewhat empty land when it came to people allready living there.
For the expansion of sorland they chose someone a bit less conventional, a lady by the name Medika Olafsdottir, while this young lady was somewhat untested many was of the opinion that she had great potential and had learned studiously from her father Olafs hard earned wisdom as a offical of Nordiheim in the maters of planing and organisation of both development and land expansion, as such she would be tasked with expanding the region of sorland up to were the river 'Njord' flowed from vestland and into Lake Lifvatn in the west.
It also helped that her mother had been a respected priestess of 'Freyja' wich ment that the high priest and the Asatru church not only had nothing ageinst her being chosen for this task but would also offer support to her work wich would make tings easier for the council.
Material and money would also have to be gathered for this, some materials were easy to get such as stone, mortar and metal, but timber would have to be sendt from ostland wich ment they would have to be a bit carefull so that it wouden't atract atention, money was tankfully starting to get easier to come by as the access to trade by sea had opened their economy to a larg potential market that they had never had before.
This brought the council neatly into their next mater as it was partly conected to the expansion of their land in several ways as well as the great plan as a whole.

[b]Ships, crosbows and experience[/b]
The Golden Library had been a treasure trove not only in information and old tradition to make use of, it had also contained schematics and blueprints of old that had been partialy or compleatly lost to the Nordiheimians, among these were how to construct the ships of the old empire both for war, transport and trade.
Not only had they found the schematics of the war ship that the golden nobles liked to use, named the Sea Dragon, with how to find its weaknesses and strenghts but also another war ship named the Sea Serpent, or Sea Drake as some nordiheimians had allready taken to calling them, while the Sea Dragon was a large and heavy ship that was fast in a straight line but bad at making fast turns but made to hold a lot of warriors and equipment and used for ramming its target, allowing the Dragon Warriors to board an enemy ship and do what they were the best at, the Sea Serpent/Drake was a slightly smaller and more streamlined ship that was both fast and agile with space for either a ballista of catapult on its front section that were able to be turned to fire in different directions yet still being able to transport a decent amound of people and suplies.
The council had allready given the order to make a lot of this ship and some had allready been put into use, some had been sendt to Olia so that Aegir Njordrson could get to know them and put them to some testing, not only had he showed that hes tallent for sailing translated rather flawlessly to the sea but he had allready sendt his first raport about the strenght and weaknesses of the Sea Serpent/Drake ship but also a few notes about how they should use them ageinst the Sea Dragon ships that the golden nobles liked so much by pointing out that the majorety of them should be equiped with ballista as they should be able to pierce the hull of the Sea Dragon ships right over were their ramming reinforcements in their hull stopped, apparently he had a plan of how to exploit that wich the council were eager to hear back about.

The other Sea Serpent/Drake ships that had been made was used by mercenary bands that had been sett up, they had found that the best way to not only get their soldiers experience not only in sailing the ships in combat but also combat experience in general was to creat large mercenary gangs to sail out and offer their services to other nations and factions for a price, and since they were all trained soldiers that were able to demand a decent price to, while this did expose them to the danger of them loosing men and ships that had not been a problem so far, in addition it not only allowed their soldiers to gain battle experience without the golden nobles being any the wiser it also allowed the council to gain a small stream of proffit as the price for their mercenaries services was greater then the endavor cost in suplies and soldier pay, and they weren't payed badly either, this allowed them to expand this operation to a larger scalle then they had initialy tought they could afford.

Another ting that they had started making in great numbers and training people to use was crossbows, and ballista to offcourse, a ranged weapon they had heard about in a few old tales but not known how to creat before now with information gained from the Golden Library, they had tested them on some replicas they had made of the armor used by the Dragon Warriors and found that the bigger variants of the crossbow had the ability to pierce them at medium range, tough this variant wasen't the fasted to reload it was not to bad and defenitly worth it as they had found that most of the bows they usualy used for war strugled to do the same even at close range unless they had a heavy draw weight, a draw weight that not many archers had the ability to use, as such crossbows would be important in the battles they would inevitably have to fight ageinst the Dragon Warriors no mater how good their plan was or how flawlessly it was executed.
They had also found that they would need to change what types of weapons their soldiers was usualy equiped with, swords would not work well ageinst the Dragon Warriors heavy plate armor nor would many of the broad headed axes they tended to favor, even the boomerangs that the soldiers of some areas liked to use would have limite effect, if any, on the thick armor that the Dragon Warriors used.
Though there was one weapon that were in wide use by Nordiheimian soldiers from vestland that did prove decent at dealing with the heavy armor that was called a Lil-lil club, its was made of either iron or steel and bendt to allow its large head to get around shields to take down the peson hiding behind it, the amount of force that a peson could get out of it when propperly trained would easely cave inn the helmet used by the Dragon Warriors or severly dent the plate parts of their armor, the blacksmiths of Nordiheim were able to use what was learned from its use in tested to start making weapons that worked much in the same way but with more narrow ends to function like a spike to penetrate the heavy armor with the kinetic force gained from the soldiers swinging the weapon, some even had two sides to them were one side had a spike and the other having a blunt hammer head.
They also made a new type of spear, while spears wouldn't be the most effective at killing them they still could be used to wound or keep them at bay, this spear was slightly shorther then a normal spear but more sturdy and with a spear point that did not have the normal flaring of the edge but more of a singl sharp point like a spike, this would allow it to be braced to allow it to impale a charging dragon warrior and then pulled out without it getting stuck, tough in the hands of someone that was strong of body it could also be used to pierce the enemy with a strong strust.
It would take a bit of time to change out the swords and broad axes used by many soldiers and train them in the use of their new weapons but it was someting that would have to be done, aswell as equiping everyone with thin bladed stabing stiletto daggers to use against armor weak points for when they could be able  to overwelm Dragon Warriors with numbers or fought them in enclosed close quarters combat.

[b]Speed could be the key[/b]
The minister of war was rather big on geting tings ready as soon as possible, if a great opportunety were to sudenly present itself they needed to be ready enough to make use of it unless they they miss it, as such it was important that not only equipment and training for the future war to get rid of the golden nobles was done before it was needed but also that the undermining of their influence trough fear and subjugation of the mind and spirit of the Ostlandians and Olians was done both propperly but also with what speed they could afford, the western and southern part of Ostland showed good signs of this working, but the influencing of ostlandians in eastern part was comming up as constantly changing, while this wasen't entierly unexpected as that was were the golden nobles had most of the potentualy hiden land they weren't telling them about it also pointed at there being someting ells going on, someting important must be in that area as not only was that were the largest consentration of Dragon Warriors was but it also was the area that their spies and shadow keepers seemed to have problems infiltrating, there was even reports of hostile actions that their agenst had to avoid being encountered in that area as well as everyting being more closely observed and investigated by people that was either a sub branch of the Dragon Warriors or a potentialy unkown branch of servants of the golden nobles that they had not told them about.
As such it might be possible for their plans and deception to be uncovered by the golden nobles at any time if they try to dig to deep without knowing more.

They also needed more reports to come inn from Aegir Njordrson about how reseptive the Olians were to activly go ageinst the golden nobles and not succumb to their fear of retalliation from the Dragon Warriors, so far his few reports had been mostly about local defences and Dragon Warriors numbers aswell as sea warefare and the testing of the new war ship.
Not a lot of information had been given about his dealings with and befriending of the Olians exept that they had rechived him with a friendly attitude and openess to the changes he was doing there, the minister of war wanted more details about them and how their part in it all would be.
Some of the other ministers on the other hand did not mind the approach that was being used towards the Olians, they had been people almoust as broken down as the Ostlandians but whit the addition of not being from the same historical and cultural background, Aegir was most likely trying to find out how to approach them in their cultures way so that they would both feel some sorth of loyalty to the Nordiheimians and also gain the hope that it all could actualy work, as such the council decided it was for the best to be patient and wait for when a proper report would come without them rushing it. 

[b]The report about the meeting with the Northerners[/b]
After the delegation from "North Ostland" had shailed back to their northern land the council had wasted no time to find the people they needed to be sendt to meet the northerners elders to get them onboard with their plan and what their role would be in it all, the group had sailed northwards less then two months after the "North Ostland" delegation had saild home. 
While it had taken a bit of time the report, and other documents, about the meeting with the elders of the Northerners to come back to them it had finaly done so after a whole year had gone by with only minor reports form Hilda that tings had been going forward.
It seemed that their decission to send the stoic vesterner Thormod Allambeesen, who had also been the one in charge of the diplomatic team that had been sendt to Irohgrad to negotiate their joining with Nordiheim, had been the correct choise as the Northerners seemed to have found it easy to talk and negotiate with him, this wasen't entierly unexpected as old stories and history books had claimed that the northerners had historicaly always been closer to the westerners then the other three groups, apparently they found the midelgarders to tink to fancy and have a tongue with to much silver and the southerners religous ways to be a bit extreem for their taste.
Hildas part of the report, together with her smaller reports, described the northerners as a stoick people that found honor, truth and forwardness as desirable traits, someting that most vestlandians also did, they were also a warrior people that did not bow easely to rulers that they did not see as having a good reason to rule and as such wanted to see the golden nobles brought down so was absolutely on board with joining the Nordiheimian plan to get rid of them.

One ting that the council found interesting was that the golden nobles claim of having conquered them had not been as compleat as they had made it seem, several clans and groups that was part of the Northerners former "Republiken af Nordland" was still free and had never been conqoured by the Dragon Warrior armies, this seemed to have two reasons for having happened, one was that the golden nobles had been going for the biggest and wealtiest cities and parts and the other becose they had been using somewhat faulty information about what was and wasen't northerners, someting the northerners had no problem using to their advantage, as such they had only taken over a little over half the land that had been part of the "Republiken af Nordland" with seemingly little knowledge or even care that this was the case.

The council had also recived a document that contained the basics of the Northerners history and how they had ended up were they now called home, and it was a tale that shared some similarities with there own but also parts that was compleatly different, pluss a some supricing but informative information.

[i][u]The history of the Northerners:[/u][/i]

Joust like with the tales from the exodus that the Nordiheimians knew about the Northerners left the exodus fleet when they got to the continent east of Elseyr at about 1016 BC, more spesific the south-western part of West Shamat, and in the begining the life of the Northerners looked good.
The costal land they settled was not realy very populated with enough space to accomedate their inclusion and the local native people that lived further inland did not mind their new neighbors as they diden't start any trouble and even traded the fish they caught with them at fair rates, another ting that proberly helped in this was that no nobles revealed themself as the Northerners group had been on the look out for anyone trying to hide among them before the exodus left the old empire, unlike the other groups, as they had a peticular dislike of them wich made it look like everyting were going to be good.

But this all would change when a new fleet would arrive at their new home around 998 BC, this fleet contained 9 noble families and their entourage.
The Northerners imidiatly recogniced these nobles as they were from the noble houses of the north were they were from and they wasted no time using the private soldiers they had brought with them to claim lordship over the Northerners and the land they had settled.
While a few Northerners bowed to them the vast majority did not, but even if the Northerners were of a warrior culture they could not resist the might of the nobles soldiers as they lacked weapons and armor to do so, as such they had to comply for the time being as the nobles started their oppresive rule over them.
In addition the nobles refused to answer any  questions or inquiries about the state of the empire exept for one claim, that they acted with imperial blessing of the emperor to sett up a new imperial region with their families as the local ruling houses.

Unfortunatly it did not take the nobles long to make live horrible for not only the Northerners but also the native people, they soured the relations with the native people and even turned them hostile rather quickly by several desicions and laws that can only be called stupid.
They mandated that all trade with the locals be made at incredibly unfair rates, by law the local natives had basicly no rights and could be used as the nobles saw fit, those that lived in the land that they now claimed as theirs had to obey without question or be pushed of their land or killed, not that the ones that did obey were trully safe from persecution anyway, and they started attempts to expand their new regions power by attacking villages around them and enslaving the locals they captured.
This naturaly made the natives start to band together to be able to counter these attacks, The Notherners also quickly started to aid the natives to achive this wich allowed them to stop the attacks by the nobles soldiers and start pushing back ageinst them after a few years.

As the nobles started to lose their precious soldiers, and the power that they allowed them, the Northerners also took up arms ageinst them and joined the natives as allies in their fight ageinst the nobles as they pushed further and further into their claimed land to take them down, tough this "alliance" would be a shaky one as the natives felt that these nobles only were here becaus of them, by 989 BC they had them cornered in the small fortified city that the nobles had made their seat of power.
The original name of this city is forgoten as it was not considered important and is instead known among the Northerners as "Fools Grave" for it was there most of the 9 noble families would loose their life at either their hands or the natives, while the city was fortified it did not have great walls of stone, moats or other great embattlements but rather wooden palisades and raised sections made of dirt and rocks, as such its siege did not last long before angry natives and Northerners breached its defences and started killing any nobles they found, aswell as anyone that remained loyal to them.

Three noble families would unfortunatly escape in some capasity tough, by use of the ships they still had and could man, and among them was two families with names that the Nordiheimian council recogniced immidiatly, the House of Tyrsblod and the house of Falkenskiold.
While it was not supricing that they had traveled to the golden nobles of Ostland and eventualy been integrated among them it was a great suprice that the house of Tyrsblod had become one of the three strongest houses, most likely they must have had someting in their possesion that allowed them power and had played the games of intrigue that nobles are want to do with exeptional skill and fortune wich would explain why they were the greatest hurdle that the Nodiheimians would have to get over to achive their goal, the council decided that more assets would have to be used not only in keeping an eye on this house but also to counter anyting they might try.
This also explained why the golden nobles had been so adamant about conquring the new land that the Northerners would end up eventualy settle, the honor and dignity of their houses demaned that they bring the rebelious people back under their rule.

After the nobles had either fled or been killed the battle for the natives and Northerners was over and they were free ones more, the "imperial region" had not managed to exist more then 20 years at most, tough there was one ting that could not be changed even tough the nobles had been defeated, the natives of the land did not want the Northerners among them anymore.
Many of the natives was of the opinion that the nobles had only come here and killed many of their fellow people because the outsiders that called themself the Northerners had come to their land and settled and that there was no way of being sure that more hostile outsiders woulden't come as long as they were there, some were more forgiving and pointed out that they had joined them in fighting these evil outsider nobles and their loyal men the moment that they were able to, even helping them with information and the knowledge to make bether weapons while the nobles still had the ability to keep them in line with their soldiers, though a few also wanted to simply kill them to make sure that they were permanently gone.
This led to a situation of tension among the different groups of natives that treatened to spill into a potentialy bloody result untill the elders of the Northerners presented them with their own choice, to prevent more hostility and recognising that staying here would be foolish the Northerners would take the ships that remained from their original ships pluss the ships that the nobles  abandoned as they could not man them and leave this land.
While not all the leaders of the native people saw it as the perfect solutions they could all accept this, tough some demanded that they not only sailed until they passed an island larger then the ones that was right of their coast but aslo sail until they pased a secound on that was larger while going in the same direction, this would ensure that they would sail far away from their land, this the elders of the Northerners promis of honor to follow to gain the natives aproval of them leaving after gathering the food and suplies that they would need for their journey.

In 977 BC, after gathering the food and suplies they needed aswell as making sure that all the ships were in good condition and could hold all of their people for the journey the Northerners ones more set sail on the ocean, they would follow the coast of Shamat more or less east-ward as a sailing trader that they had encountered while preparing for their jounrey had told them that several islands existed in that direction that was larger then the local ones, their old ships might have still been sea worty but they were heavier and more cramped now then what they had been in the exodus and so it was not wise to sail them for longer then necesary lest they wanted to experience a disease outbreake.
The journey still took a few months before they passed the first island that would fit the criteria of the promis that was made and then another for the secound island wich was part of a small archipelago, then traveling for a few more weeks in a north-eastern direction untill they made landfall on what would be their secound try for a new home.

This new coastal land had no locals living there wich made it much easier and faster for them to sett up their new home wich they decided to actualy give a the name Nordland after their old ancestral homeland and would now call themself the Nordlandians ones more, by the time all ships had anchored and the people made landfall to make their new towns and farms to make life secure the year crept over to 976 BC, they would infact not meet any native people before 922 BC as they started expanding their lands north to accommodate their now booming population.

The people they encountered further north called themself the Bantu and they were actualy not from that peticular area themself, having migrated there from the south about 50 years ago to avoid more agressive tribes, they were at first some what suspicious and cautious toward the Nordlandians as they were much larger then them and every one of them seemed to carry a weapon of some kind, either a sword or axe, made from a powerfull material that they never encountered before.
The people in charge of the Nordlandians that was in charge of the people going north had been young men back when they had left on their secound journey and so wanted to avoid history repeating it self in this land and aproched these Bantu after disarming themself and their men to show that they were not hostile and trusted the Bantu to not be so either.
Trough fate or luck this would show itself to be the best possible choise aproche them  as that was how the Bantu also showed that they were not hostile in their own culture, as such their first propper meeting would be marked with understanding and a mutual wish of peace even if they could not yet propperly comunicate.
Through patient use of body language and drawing pictures in the ground the first kind of understanding would be reached as they managed to show each other were the other lived, what they produced and were they came from, this would sett up an important basis of future trade, intermingling and eventualy a joining of people.

Over the next hundreds of years the Nordlandians and Bantu would trade with each other to get what they did not have but the other did, they would learn each others languages tough the Nordlandians would learn the Bantu language more then the Bantu learned norse as that was the easiest to allow them to understand each other, and eventualy people form both sides would intermarry and have children allowing their cultures and people to mix and borders to become blurry and almoust non existing.
But the biggest event that would bring their people together as one that happened in 101 BC when one of the hostile tribes from the Bantus old lands in the north came south and found them, this tribe was known as the Tswana by the Bantu and had ones been a brother people that had truned hostile as food had become harder to get, now they had come to take what the Bantu had buildt as they had managed to find out were they had gone and that they had aquired a stable source of food.

At first there was skirmishes and small classes among the two people but this would only get worse as more and more groups Tswana warriors would arrive, the Nordlandians ofcorse tried to intervine and stop a full war from happening by setting up a meeting between them self, the Bantu and the Tswana to find some compromise and telling the Tswana that it was they who provided much of the food that the Bantu had and that they would happily trade with the Tswana as well if the Bantu was left in peace and the attacks on them stopped.
Unfortunatly the Tswana was not interested in this and the leader sendt by them, the son of their cheiftain, simply saw the Nordlandians attempts at peace as a sign of weakness and fear and loadly proclaimed that not only would they destroy the Bantu but also conquer Nordland and make its people work for them to make food unless they bowed now and accepted their new masters.
When the people sendt by Nordland refused and said that their people would never accept this and would infact aid the Bantu the Tswana simply threw caution and decenty to the winds and attacked them, while several Nordlandians and Bantu was killed the Tswana was unable to kill all of them and was forced to run back to their nearby warriors while the remaining Nordlandians and Bantu ran back to the nearest Bantu village, this blatent attack in a meating of peace by the Tswana not only killed any chance of ending tings peacefully it also brought the Nordlandians immidiatly to the Bantus side as allies in arms and steeled the Bantu people for the war that now had been propperly started as it had become a winn or die situation.

While in the first months of the war the Tswana did pretty decently their progress was quickly stalled as warriors from Nordland started to arrive in Bantu lands, their way of war worked ageinst the Bantu as they had fewer warriors then them but against the Nordlandians who were much larger then them and using a mixture of iron and steel weapons and armor the Tswana warriors found themself at a loss of how do deal with them propperly as well as finding the large warriors rather intimidating in their war gear wich contained helmet that covered their face from the mouth up with someting that made them look like they were always angry and focused, the war horn the Nordlandians used also made a deep sound that the Tswana warriors would learn to fear as it almoust always signaled that a lot of Tswana was about to die.
The Nordlandians also started suplying the Bantu with iron weapons to replace their old bone and stone weapons wich allowed them to outmach the Tswana warriors in 1v1 combat.

The war would take four years, mostly because of their large numbers and their warrior cheiftains ability to hold them together and keep them fighting, before the Tswana armies would compleatly break after the last and biggest battle were their warrior chieftain and his son together with their most elite warriors would face and be killed by a army group made up of the most veteran warriors of the Bantu and Nordlandians, this allowed the two allies to dellivering the killing blow to the Tswana together with both of them as equals, an important event in their shared history.

With the Tswana defeated and fleeing back north peace was ones more returned to the lands of the Bantu and Nordlandians they would only grow closer and more intermingled as they rebuild the damage from the war and even more of their peoples intermarrying and mixing together becaus of the bond that had been forged between them from fighting together side by side ageinst a common enemy.
As the age was about to go into a new millenium this almoust compleat mixing of their peoples made the elders and leaders of their two people decide on a joining of their people as one nation, for the border between them was practicaly pointless and almoust as many Bantu lived in Nordland as there was Nordlandians and the same was true of Bantu lands, the mixing of blood had also grown to encompass almoust half their peoples so they were almoust one people in blood anyway.
They decided to keep the name of Nordland for their new unified nation as the Bantu did not realy have their own name for their land and they did not mind it either way, they also decided to have it be ruled by the elders of both their people that would be chosen by their people for showing the greatest ability and wisdom in leadership.
The full name of their nation would be "Republiken af Nordland"(Republic of Nordland) and its officail day of founding was february 12th in the year 1 AD, republic was a name for a nations leadership that they had heard about from travelers and merchants that passed trough their harbors that for the most part seemed similar to how their leadership would function so they simply used it.

For over 900 years they lived in relative peace with only minor skirmishes and wars from sorounding tribes or warlords that wanted to try and get their hands on what they had but none was succesfull in posing a huge treath to their republic, their people grew in numbers and prosperity and mixed ever more to the point that finding anyone of the original two peoples that was "pure blooded" was next to imposible, there was even a few times that tribes would settle besides their land and eventualy mix with them and join into their nation.
But this came to a brutal and bloody end in 921 AD when a army of 10'000 Dragon Warriors from the Golden Kingdom of Ostland landed on their shores at the command of their golden nobles with one demand, bow to the golden nobles and their "right" to rule them or be conqured, while they would lose in the end the Nordlandians did not need much time to declare that they would not bow to these "golden nobles" and would fight them with everyting they had.
This led to a 10 year long war that was both bloody and bither, while they would slowly but constantly lose ground to the armies of the golden nobles they would in turn make them lose so many of their original 10'000 precious Dragon Warriors that they had to send another 10'000 to finish the war they had started, in the end almoust 7000 Dragon Warriors was killed, many by cavalry men on horse or cammel piercing their thick armor with lances in charges or using their heavy hacking swords or maces to smash their heads inn in meeles with this same tactic being used in the defence of forts and castles were they would bash their heads inn when they tried to get climb their walls.

But for some reason the golden nobles did not attack all of their cities and territories instead going for the larges cities and oldest lands while leaving newer land and small towns and cities and the edges of their nation alone, the Nordlandians had no clue why they diden't conquer t all, perhaps they did not now were all their land was or maybe they had been weakened to much to go for them, but they were not going to complain about such a stroke of luck, instead these areas would become gathering points for their surviving forces and places of planing for when they would ones more fight for their freedom for they had learned quite a bit about the Dragon Warriors and how to best fight them and they intended to use what they had learned for joust that.
Especialy since they had since learned that the three golden nobles that had been the most adamant about conquering them had been the three noble families that had escaped from them all those centuries, they gave the demand that if the Nordiheimian managed to capture any of them that they were to be given to them so that they could execute them personaly for what they had brought upon them.
The rest of their history was pretty much allready known by the Nordiheimians.

The one ting that the Nordlandian elders could not answer them tough was why their Northerner ancestors did not sail after the other norse groups of the exodus after they had to leave their first new home, the elders had told them that noting had been passed on about this tough some of the elders had two teories, either they did not want to risk trying to go after them as they did not know exactly were they had gone or they had perhaps felt to much shame or embarasment about what had happened to go and join them again.
What ever the reason was would proberly never be known.

The council took great care in reading trough the historical recountings of the Northerners, or Nordlandians as they were now called, it would have to be added to their historical libraries to be preserved for future generations, the minister of war also read the book about the Dragon Warriors that had been provided by the Nordlandian elders with extreeme interest, it had information about their abilities in battle that they not only laced but that also gave them a bether understanding about joust how devestating they could be, apparently they seemed to have a almoust inexhaustible stamina and also seemed to be trained to an extreeme in physical abilities making them joust bether then a normal soldier in every way, but they still had many of the same weaknesses as any other human, cave their skull inn or bleed them out with wounds and they die like anyone ells.
Another ting they would have to figure out was how fast they could replenish their lost numbers, with aparently almoust 7000 lost in their war to conquer Nordland almoust 50 years ago had they replenished these losses in full or was that still ongoing?
All members of the council agreed that this was a question that was important to find the answer for.

Another question that needed a answer was what Knut of Smør had been up to resently, and how was his 'project' of draging the house of Gyldenhorn into his dept going?

[b]Knuts raport and manipulations of the Gyldenhorn.[/b]
Up north of Nordiheim in the western part of Ostland Knut had been a buisy man, not only had he sendt a letter to his brother Lars to offer him some advise in what the golden nobles might find irresistble in a price he had also been dealing with the discorvery of the Ostland ownership of the two islands of its coast that the golden nobles seemed to have "forgotten" to tell them about, while he had no doupt that there was territoris that was being held hidden by some of the golden nobles, Tyrsblod in paticular, part of him actualy wondered if these islands was actualy joust forgotten by them as the Ostlandians that lived there seemed to be in slightly better health that the ones they had met on the mainland with less oversight and rules hindering them.
The two forts on the islands were a bit more concearning as each was maned by 100 Dragon warriors each wich was not part of the Dragon Warrior numbers that had been provided to them, this pointed out the danger of not knowing the full extent of the golden nobles territories as they most likely had more Dragon Warriors that was unacounted for in those aswell, or "forgotten about" as they liked to say, there was also the part of these paticular Dragon Warriors belonging to house Gyldenhorn wich ment that he had not gotten them deep enough into dept with him to make them fully open up to him to try and pay down this dept, but he had an idea how to achive this.

When he heard that the council apointing people to the task of increasing the size of the Nordiheimian regions he figured that leaking certain details and hints to Lord Morten to encourage him to expand his land in the western direction and make it seem lived inn to allow it to not only count as "old" land but to potentialy boost his ranking among the golden nobles as the absolutly weakest to atleast be higher then Lord Otto Falkenskiold wich would potentially weaken house Tyrsblod position but also put house Gyldenhorn in such a position of dept that they would basicly make them his vassal as far as the 'game of nobles' was concearned.
He could also use the exuse of touring house Gyldenhorns tottaly "old" land to get good idea of their tottal strenght both in millitary and resources.

This little plan worked amazingly with Lord Morten not only jumping on this oportunity with great eagerness but also seeming to quickly figuring out that he could potentialy use Knuts "hints" and "advice" to elevate his house out of the sad position of 'weakest of the golden noble houses' to someting great like his ancestors had ones apparently been,
As he got the expansion of his land westward underway with great speed he also seemed to go from joust trying to gain favor with 'Lord' Knut to seemingly trying to become part of the "Nordiheimian noble faction" as the golden nobles seemed to call the trio of Kunt, Gaute and Gurin, this was someting Knut had no problem using to his advantage.
Many spies and shadow keepers seeded trough the network and channels of the lesser and middel rank golden nobles trough Lord Mortens increasing desire to join the "Nordiheim noble faction" that had so far been difficult to infiltrate, tough there was given a general order to these agenst of being carefull when going deeper as they were now pretty sure that there was some kind of group or organisation being used by the golden nobles to keep spies in check even if they diden't know exactly who they reported to, but Lord Haakon was most likely among one of these.

A new hiden port town was also created inside house Gyldenhorns expansion that could would allow Nordiheim to better and faster send out and welcome back the mercenary bands and small armies that they were sending out and actualy gaining money from with less chance of the golden nobles discovering it, so far they had been sending them out of several small port towns and villages in fragmented groups that would later get together out in the ocean wich took extra time and cordination but now they would no longer need to do this.
Lord Morten for his part tought that this port that he had "gifted" to Knut was joust being used for deals and trades that the ruling lord diden't want the other nobles to know about wich ironicaly wasen't wrong yet ment that the poor guy was unkowingly helping the Nordiheimian councils plans more dirrectly then ever before.

While some of the ministers of Nordiheims council was somewhat consearned that Knut was starting to get a bit independant others pointed out that not only was it proving to be a boon for them but neither Hilda or the other shadow keepers and agents that was keeping an eye on him reported any signs of shady or treacherous intent of any kind wich would signal that he was indeed doing it for the advantage of Nordiheim.
The minister of wisdom personaly wrote a short message on the behalf of the council that spoke positivly about the young mans forward tinking actions and gave him permission to do so again in the future but that the information of what he did had to be reported to them as fast as reasonable possible so that no plans or actions would get in the way of another, this message was sendt trough the channels of the shadow order conected to his "secretary" Hilda.[/spoiler]
